rationale.correct: Per NSCP, the Philippines has two seismic zones: Zone 1 (Z=0.2, lower risk, covering Palawan/Tawi-Tawi/Sulu) and Zone 2 (Z=0.4, higher risk, covering all other provinces including Metro Manila). Metro Manila is in Zone 2 with Z = 0.4.
rationale.takeaway: The Philippines uses a two-zone seismic system. Zone 2 (Z=0.4) applies to all provinces except Palawan, Tawi-Tawi, and Sulu.
